answer: Every epoch the network sends a surprise audit to all IDs in the same second. Each ID gets its own task, such as summarising a glacier sensor log or tagging the characters in a fable, and has 4 seconds to answer. One GPU cannot answer for 300 fakes at once, so a farm has to keep 300 inference slots warm all day for an audit that could come at any moment. At about $0.40 per slot-hour, the cost grows with every fake added. In our mesa cluster test, one round dropped 91% of a 500-ID farm.
